name: omni-downloader
description: Descargador de videos para YouTube, Facebook y TikTok

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); const p = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'yt-dlp.exe' : 'yt-dlp'; cp.execSync('node_modules/youtube-dl-exec/bin/' + p + ' --update-to nightly', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
